The target arithmetic is consistent with the same mutually exclusive category definitions, but the target ID list and target-side source records are not present in the repository, so the 330 missing IDs cannot be identified or set-compared.
The 78-record final difference is entirely B/LB in the supplied aggregate counts; this remains material to class balance and all downstream denominators.
The code change corrects audit semantics only. It does not alter the frozen t0/t1 archives, primary gate, normalized-ID policy, duplicate policy, or any model-scoring authorization.
decision: Phase 3 remains BLOCKED; do not score the current cohort as the handoff cohort until the missing target IDs/source provenance are reconciled or a dated protocol deviation accepts the changed cohort.
